title: Full faithfulness of finite-coefficient comparison in the ordinary presentation
statement: Let k be a finite or algebraically closed field, let l be a prime invertible in k, and let A be a finite discrete commutative ring annihilated by some power of l. For every quasi-compact scheme locally of finite type over k, comparison inverse image on the ordinary unbounded derived categories of A-module sheaves is fully faithful. These are the fixed scalar presentations of def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules and def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism.

source.place: opening paragraph: finite-Tor generators correspond under comparison

proof.text: Apply unboundedSiteComparison to the recorded ringed-coefficient derived comparison. The exact realization from ordinary A-module sheaves is an equivalence. Its derived functor is an equivalence, hence faithful. The exact-functor composition isomorphism factors the ringed derived comparison as ordinary comparison followed by derived realization. Cancel this faithful factor to obtain fullness, and cancel the composite to obtain faithfulness. This includes the zero ring and empty scheme.

theorem finiteComparisonOrdinary_fullyFaithful
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [TopologicalSpace A]
    [DiscreteTopology A] [Finite A]
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (hbase : Finite k ∨ IsAlgClosed k)
    {ℓ : ℕ} [Fact ℓ.Prime] (hℓ : IsUnit (algebraMap ℤ k (ℓ : ℤ)))
    (hA : ∃ n : ℕ, (ℓ : A) ^ n = 0)
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] :
    Nonempty ((comparisonUpperStar
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X).mapDerivedCategory).FullyFaithful
